long_biography.plain_text:
After more than half a century at Bernkopf Goodman, Kenneth Goldberg left with colleagues to establish GoldMark Partners. The move created a smaller practice devoted to property and commercial transactions. He wanted the legal rigour associated with a large Boston firm alongside the responsiveness and personal service of a suburban office.

His work includes evaluating asset-backed borrowing, arranging and closing financing, and advising on purchases of loan portfolios. He also handles the restructuring of existing loans, representing buyers, sellers and lenders. Outside the office, his interests include sport fishing and collecting cars.
